reserveReview.rationale: The issuer's 5 October 2026 CSV maps 39,000 XGZ across 39 Heraeus bar serials, each allocated 1,000 XGZ, with Horsemart Service Limited named as vault in every row. Its 298 rows cover 260 addresses. The total matches 39,000 XGZ at Ethereum block 26198051 (2026-10-15T12:55:59Z), but matching token arithmetic is not independent verification of 39 kg of physical gold. Terms name GoldZip Digital Pte Ltd as administrator/redemption counterparty, the obligor in this slice. Clauses 4.2-4.3 deny holders proprietary interest in stored bars and pass title only on collection. Independent reserve reports, account segregation and insolvency safeguards remain unverified.
